newsitem.title: USA: Plastic Container Inc to buy back senior debt.
newsitem.headline: Plastic Container Inc to buy back senior debt.

text.p: Plastic Containers Inc said on Friday it was offering to buy all its 10-3/4 percent senior secured notes due 2001 for $1,042 per $1,000 principal amount, to be partly financed by a new debt offering.
It also said it was seeking consent to modify the indenture governing senior secured notes and was offering to pay a $10 consent fee per $1,000 principal amount.
Holders who tendered their senior secured notes also had to provide the consent, Plastic said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation was acting as dealer manager for the tender offer and consent.
